headline: Kenya Picks US Consortium Over China for Sh8 Trillion Mrima Hill Rare Earth Project
summary: Kenya selected a consortium of US companies to develop the Mrima Hill rare earth and niobium deposit, valued at over Sh8 trillion, beating rival proposals from Chinese state firms.
why: Niobium and rare earth elements are vital for critical defense, aerospace, and energy transition technologies amid global supply chain decoupling.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Selecting the US consortium activates large-scale foreign capital investment in Kenya's mining sector.
